entries.zh: 救急；危急时救助、济人之急
entries.en: to help in an emergency; to give urgent relief (socorrer)

entries.zh: 救助；接济（第二字「繫」存疑）
entries.en: to rescue and relieve; to give aid (socorrer)
entries.notes: H 第二字「繫」与 socorrer 词群不相应且非常规搭配，救助义系据词群推断

entries.zh: 赈济；以钱粮救济（原稿字面作「跟濟」）
entries.en: to relieve with money and grain; famine relief (socorrer)
entries.notes: 字面「跟濟」不成词，据音读 chin-chey 与词群定为「赈济」义

entries.zh: 济急；救济急难（中间「繫」字存疑）
entries.en: to relieve urgent need; emergency aid (socorrer)
entries.notes: 中字「繫」存疑（或系行旁添小字），济急义据首尾字与词群推断

entries.zh: 周急；救济急难之人（「周急不继富」之周急）
entries.en: to relieve those in urgent need (socorrer)

entries.zh: 周济；以财物救济贫者
entries.en: to give charity; to relieve with money and goods (socorrer)

entries.zh: 疼痛；身体痛楚
entries.en: pain; ache; to hurt, feel pain
entries.notes: L 栏作 so correr tener la última（疑串行误读或磨损），与「痛疼」不相应，据 H/M 定疼痛义

entries.zh: 疼痛；痛苦
entries.en: pain; ache; to hurt
entries.notes: L 栏 tener la última 疑串行或磨损；与上条为「痛疼／疼痛」字序倒换，义同，据 H/M 定

entries.zh: 恤贫；怜悯并救济穷人
entries.en: to take pity on and relieve the poor; to aid the poor (socorrer el pobre)

entries.zh: 救险难；解救危难困厄（「難」字系行旁添）
entries.en: to rescue from danger and distress; to deliver from peril
entries.notes: L 承上条圈连、无独立西语释义，救助危难义据 H/M 三字定

entries.zh: 口粮；士兵的口粮、粮饷配给
entries.en: rations; provisions (food allowance, esp. for soldiers)

entries.zh: 济世；救济世人
entries.en: to succour the world; to benefit mankind (socorrer)

entries.zh: 助战；出兵相助
entries.en: to aid in battle; to reinforce with troops (socorrer con soldados)

entries.zh: 义民；协助官军的地方义勇
entries.en: righteous civilians; volunteer militia who aid the (government) troops
entries.notes: L 为动词短语 socorrer a los soldados（fuera 已划删），名词「义民」系据词群与马尼拉助战语境推断

entries.zh: 阴兵；冥兵、鬼兵（旧谓阴间之兵，能助战）
entries.en: ghost soldiers; troops of the netherworld said to give aid in war (socorro de soldados)
entries.notes: L 左缘补注部分污损串读不明（u decielos 疑即 u de cielos），阴兵义据 H/M 定

entries.zh: 阴德；暗中行善、不使人知所积的功德
entries.en: hidden virtue; secret merit from good deeds done unobtrusively
entries.notes: L 无本条独立西语（承上条补注且原文污损），阴德义据 H/M 定

entries.zh: 勒马；收缰控马（字面作「消缰」，字形待考）
entries.en: to rein in the horse; to curb, check a horse (sofrenar)
entries.notes: 汉字「消韁」非常见词形（或为「收缰」误写／方言写法），勒马义据 L sofrenar al caballo 与 M siau-quio 定

entries.zh: 缭；系船的缆绳、大绳（缭索）
entries.en: rope; hawser, mooring line; also to coil or tie around (soga)

entries.zh: 〔释义存疑〕字迹难辨（或「壖」或「堄」），确义未能定夺
entries.en: gloss uncertain: character unresolved (壖/堄); sense undetermined
entries.notes: 封存件标记 [疑:壖/堄]，M 第二音节未解（numeral 为西语遗留），与 L「soga, numeral」未获可靠对应

entries.zh: 条；长条之物，用作量词（一条，与「soga」作计数单位合）
entries.en: strip; long slender thing; classifier (numeral) for string-like objects, "a strand/length of"
entries.notes: M 第二音节 ios 未解；「soga, numeral」解作量词「一条」系据词序与词义推断
